title: DVA Configuration Schema
description: Schema for the dva.yml configuration file

app_exec_paths.description: Native and/or docker execution paths for an application command.

native.description: Shell command to run on host

ready_timeout.description: Timeout in seconds to wait for readiness

oneOf.description: Array of .env file paths (later files override earlier)

required.description: Whether env files are required to exist

oneOf.description: Step-based command with name, run commands, and optional notes

step.description: Name of the step (displayed with progress indicator)

run.description: Command(s) to execute for this step

compose_up.description: Docker Compose services to start (inherits compose config)

compose_exec.description: Command to execute in a compose service

compose_run.description: One-off command in a compose service

parallel.description: Run this step concurrently with other consecutive parallel steps

service.description: Specifies the service associated with the command

command.description: Represents the command to be executed

workdir.description: Specifies the working directory for the command

user.description: Specifies the user to run the command as

method.description: Specifies the Docker Compose method (e.g., up, run)

compose_method.description: Specifies an alternative Docker Compose method to use in compose commands

run_options.description: Options to pass to the 'docker-compose run' command

pod.description: Specifies the pod for the kubectl runner

subcommands.description: Contains subcommands with the same structure as main commands

tags.description: Tags for categorizing this command (e.g., test, quality, infra)

before.description: Steps to run before a hookable built-in command (up, down, stop, restart, build, clean, logs)

replace.description: Steps that replace the built-in command entirely

after.description: Steps to run after the built-in command completes successfully

version.description: Specifies the minimum required version of DVA. Must not exceed the installed DVA version, or the config is rejected.

vars.description: Global variables injected into all execution contexts. Merged with environment, site, and plan vars at runtime. Priority (lowest to highest): env_file < global vars < environment vars < site vars < plan vars < CLI vars < OS environment variables. An OS environment variable always wins: no dva.yml layer (not even --var) can override a key that is set in the OS environment.

plans.description: Named execution plans. Each plan combines stack entries, environment, site, and vars into an executable configuration. Use 'dva up <plan-name>' to execute.

environment.description: Environment name to apply (references environments section)

site.description: Site name to apply (references sites section)

vars.description: Plan-level variables (highest priority after CLI override)

entries.description: Ordered list of stack entry references with execution parameters

runner.description: Runner to use from the stack entry's runners map

depends_on.description: Names of other plan entries that must complete first

services.description: Compose service subset to start (compose runner only)

sites.description: Named host-based execution conditions. Sites represent where DVA runs (local, office, remote, cloud), not the deployment target.

runner.description: Override runner selection for this stack entry

vars.description: Additional variables for this entry in this site

stack.description: Named stack declarations. Compose must be declared through stack.<entry>.runners.compose; legacy stack.<entry>.compose and plugin: compose shapes are rejected by schema validation.

default_runner.description: Default runner name when not specified in plan entry. Must reference a key in the runners map.

description.description: Human-readable description of this stack declaration

runners.description: Map of runner name to runner configuration. Keys must be one of the runner names the config decoder accepts (see decodeRunnerNode in internal/config/lifecycle.go). Unknown runner names and unknown keys inside a runner are rejected.

plugin.description: Legacy flat plugin type for non-compose plugins. Compose declarations must use runners.compose.

order.description: Execution order (ascending for up, descending for down/stop)

tags.description: Tags for categorizing this lifecycle entry

exports.description: Environment variables to export to subsequent lifecycle entries

health_checks.description: Health checks specific to this lifecycle entry

ready_timeout.description: Timeout in seconds to wait for readiness

interaction.description: Defines the commands and their configurations

provision.description: Execute commands within provision section. Keys represent provision profiles (e.g., 'default', 'reset'), each containing an array of commands to execute. Use 'default_profile' to set the default profile name.

default_profile.description: Name of the default provision profile to use when none is specified

git.description: Git repository URL for the infrastructure component

ref.description: Specifies the Git reference (branch, tag, or commit) to use

path.description: Local path to the infrastructure component

subprojects.description: Defines sub-projects that can be integrated when running DVA from a devbox (parent project)

path.description: Relative or absolute path to the sub-project directory. Declarations with no import entries, including import: {}, may point at subprojects that will be initialized later; non-empty imports and direct subproject runs require the child path to contain dva.yml.

import.description: What to import from this subproject

plans.description: Plan names to import from this subproject

as.description: Alias name in the parent namespace

exclude_tags.description: Tags to exclude when integrating this sub-project from the parent devbox

config_path.description: Path to existing devcontainer.json file to sync with

image.description: Docker image to use (alternative to dockerFile)

workspaceFolder.description: Path to workspace folder inside container

remoteUser.description: User to run as inside container

forwardPorts.description: Ports to forward from container to host

postCreateCommand.description: Command to run after container is created

postStartCommand.description: Command to run each time container starts

postAttachCommand.description: Command to run after attaching to container

default_mode.description: Mode applied automatically when dva up/down/stop/restart is called without --mode/-M. Should reference a minimal infrastructure mode (e.g., 'infra') so that dva up starts only core services by default. Use 'dva up -M full-stack' for everything.

suggestion_ignore.description: Glob patterns for Makefile/package.json targets to suppress from config suggestion warnings. Use when targets are intentionally not mapped to DVA interactions (e.g., CI-only targets, aliases covered by other interactions).

modes.description: Named operational modes for dva up (--mode/-M flag). Each mode defines which compose profiles/services to start, health checks to run, and environment overrides.

compose_profiles.description: Docker Compose profiles to activate (passed as --profile flags)

compose_services.description: Explicit list of compose services to start. Empty array = skip compose entirely (native mode). Omit = start all services.

health_checks.description: Health check names to activate (from health_checks section). Omit = use all.

endpoint_tags.description: Show only endpoints matching these tags. Omit = show all endpoints.

stack.description: Stack entry names to include in this mode. Only these entries will be started.

provision.description: Provision profile to suggest when services start for the first time

applications.description: App execution strategy for this mode. String applies to all apps; object maps per-app.

environments.description: Named environment configurations for --env/-E flag. Each environment defines environment variable overrides.

stack.description: Stack entry names to include when this environment is active (empty=all)

stack_overrides.description: Lifecycle entry overrides to apply on top of the base stack when this environment is active

agent_image.description: Docker image for the SSH agent container (default: whilp/ssh-agent)

endpoints.description: Declares user-facing endpoint URLs for the project. Use `source` to reference compose service ports (URL auto-resolved), or `url` for non-compose endpoints. Keys matching health_check names are auto-linked for status display.

url.description: User-facing access URL. Required if source is not set.

source.description: Compose service:host_port reference. DVA resolves the URL automatically from compose port mappings. Use instead of url for compose services.

tags.description: Tags for filtering (used by modes.endpoint_tags). Inherited from service tags under stack.<entry>.runners.compose if omitted.

paths.description: Sub-paths with descriptions (key: path, value: description)

health_checks.description: Health checks for non-compose services (e.g., local processes, external dependencies)

url.description: URL for http type health check

address.description: Host:port for tcp type health check

command.description: Shell command for command type health check

start.description: Shell command to auto-start this service in the background

start_hint.description: Human-readable hint shown when service is not ready (no auto-start)

ready_timeout.description: Maximum time in seconds to wait for a service to become ready after auto-start (default: 30)

checks.description: Environment checks for 'dva doctor'. Validates prerequisites before running services.

path.description: File path to check (for file_exists type)

command.description: Shell command to run (for command type, exit 0 = pass)

fix_hint.description: Suggestion shown when the check fails

fix.description: Shell command executed by `dva doctor --fix` to auto-remediate a failed check. Runs via `sh -c` from the config directory; only used when --fix is passed.

applications.description: Declares long-running application processes with native and docker execution paths. Use this section for servers, workers, and dev frontends — NOT for one-shot commands (use interaction: instead).

tags.description: Tags for filtering (e.g., app, backend, frontend)

port.description: Listening port number (shown in dva app ls)

depends_on.description: Compose services or other app names that must be running before this app starts

dir.description: Working directory for the application (default: config dir)

variants.description: Sub-components with their own build/run/dev paths. Access via dot notation: dva app build proxynd.json
